turns.question: What was our average basket size, in euros, in the week starting Monday 21 September 2026?
turns.answer: Average order value (EUR) for 21 to 27 September 2026 was €130.28 per non-cancelled order; the semantic layer has no basket-size metric, so this is the closest one. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
